# First question

## Who this is for

People with a folder called Old.

## Evaluate

Read the folder list. Change nothing.

## Propose

Show what would move. Ask: Do it now (recommended), Not now, Skip it.

## Apply

Move the approved folders, then record the answer.

## If skipped

Nothing changes. Say "run a skipped upgrade again" to come back.

## Never

Never delete a note.
